summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its ML-safe video data technology is now available on the RTMaps AI Store, an autonomous-driving development platform. The press release describes a partnership with Intempora, a dSPACE company, and highlights Beamr's content-adaptive bitrate technology (CABR) reducing file sizes by up to 50% while preserving ML accuracy. No terms, financial details, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. This is a routine product-availability announcement, not a special situation. The filing does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or capital return.
